entities.summary: The County of Cerdanya was one of the Catalan counties formed in the last decades of the 8th century by the Franks in the Marca Hispanica. The original Cerdanya consisted of the valley of the upper Segre. Today Cerdanya is a Catalan comarca. County of Cerdanya is a historical country, established around 798 CE. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
